description: This header defines various utility functions related to tensor shape manipulations, dimension handling, and permutation utilities within the torch::lazy namespace, used for tensor shape promotion, dimension normalization, and transposition.

methods.name: std::vector<int64_t> ToI64Vector(const S & input)
methods.description: Converts an iterable container to a vector of int64's.

methods.name: DropDimensions
methods.description: Creates a set of dimensions by dropping specified dimensions from the sizes.

methods.name: GetCanonicalDimensionIndex
methods.description: Returns the canonical index for the given dimension, handling negative indices.

methods.name: GetCanonicalDimensionIndices
methods.description: Returns the canonical indices for multiple dimensions.

methods.name: GetCanonicalPosition
methods.description: Returns the canonical position in dimensions, handling negative values.

methods.name: MakeTransposePermutation
methods.description: Creates a transposition permutation from two dimensions and the total rank.

methods.name: GetPromotedShape
methods.description: Calculates the broadcasted shape for elementwise tensor operations based on input shapes.

methods.name: GetPromotedBinaryOpShape
methods.description: Returns the promoted shape for binary tensor operations.

methods.name: StrSplit
methods.description: Splits a string into substrings based on a delimiter.
